purpose: Audit data, cost, cadence and inference limits; not a profitability result or authorization to trade.

evidenceMeanings.componentCloseDifference: Ask-component close minus bid-component close. Components lack a shared retained event timestamp; this is not a verified simultaneous account executable spread.
evidenceMeanings.candles: Completed OHLC prices locate retained extrema, not their temporal order or ten-second management delivery.
evidenceMeanings.rawScans: Repeated scans of the same completed candle are not independent opportunities. Include market sessions and unique pair/candle decision coverage.
evidenceMeanings.historicalLabels: All 2020-August 2026 data has prior outcome access; a holdout filename cannot restore untouched status.

demonstratedInputSensitivity.finding: Every EUR_USD and GBP_USD archived component-close difference in 2024, 2025 and January-August 2026 exceeds the configured 1.2 pip limit.
demonstratedInputSensitivity.implication: Native component-close price proxies alone would prohibit all entries in those pair-years, irrespective of setup quality. A zero count cannot establish actual historical live-account cadence.
demonstratedInputSensitivity.independentLiveContrast: Retained October 7 incident evidence contains actual EUR_USD fills and signal spreads around 0.8-1.1 pips. This differs in period and account-price evidence; it does not identify exact historical executable spreads.

prespecifiedEconomicDecisionCriteria.timing: Communicated to primary reviewer before inspecting the new historical evaluator outcomes.
prespecifiedEconomicDecisionCriteria.keep: Unchanged current-rule portfolio must support positive net expectancy after explicit executable costs and plausible path/cost sensitivities, with cluster and period uncertainty not leaving the sign unresolved; cadence and capped capital must serve a stated economic purpose.
prespecifiedEconomicDecisionCriteria.redesign: A specific demonstrated structural benefit survives costs, but an identifiable policy or implementation prevents viability; test a bounded new hypothesis without selecting a winning historical tweak as proof.
prespecifiedEconomicDecisionCriteria.scrapCurrentStrategy: No credible edge survives generous declared assumptions, or ongoing live-risk/research expenditure lacks evidence sufficient to justify keeping this strategy. This does not prove every possible replacement unprofitable.
prespecifiedEconomicDecisionCriteria.inconclusive: Contradictory, highly cost-sensitive or unresolved output fails a keep decision but is not mathematical proof profitability is impossible.
prespecifiedEconomicDecisionCriteria.noAutomaticThreshold: No fixed win rate, arbitrary trade count, confidence cutoff or existing 100-trade analytics flag proves an edge. Independent effective day/episode clusters and economic effect matter.

requiredEvaluationChecks: Preserve whole-unit sizing, AUD conversion, actual cost/spread and price-bound gates, portfolio competition/sort order, H1 reset, protected-exit state, cooldown, exposure and drawdown checks.
Preserve frozen BUY/SELL episode state continuously across research calendar boundaries. Separately label fresh-start cohort sensitivities; never pool them as one continuous account.
Apply spread once through bid/ask entry and liquidation prices. Explicit commissions/financing/fees are additional only when not already in the reported cash amount.
Use BUY bid and SELL ask evidence for stop/target liquidation. Retained target threshold contacts do not imply realized fills.
Declare per-execution adverse slippage assumptions, target fills at threshold or better, gap handling, whole-unit rounding, conversion-time assumptions and absent historical financing.
Do not invent observed quote delivery or claim OHLC high-first/low-first paths are exhaustive. Additional recrossings and management delivery/acknowledgement can alter breakeven outcomes.

Changing fixed-spread decision quotes while retaining archival bid/ask stops is a mixed proxy model. Reconstructing synchronous MBA from midpoint also changes structural-stop evidence; label each synthetic price world explicitly.

Show separate raw opportunities, admitted entries, fills, unique active days, no-trade intervals, positions remaining open and observable mark-to-market drawdown; never force a final close for convenience.
Report gross signals, conditional trade-label returns and achievable account/portfolio P&L separately. A rejected order is not a loss.
Show net AUD and net original-cash-risk R, cost/path sensitivity, by-period and by-pair concentration, effective day/episode cluster counts and unknown coverage.

economicScale.riskFormula: min(0.8 * freeMarginAud, 100) * 0.0025, before whole-unit and leverage caps, using current default 20% margin buffer
economicScale.implication: Positive expectancy at this capped capital is a research outcome, not evidence of meaningful income. Raising capital/risk does not repair negative expectancy.

officialContractSourcesChecked.supports: Candles contain interval-start time, component OHLC, volume and completion; H1/M15 are hour-aligned. OHLC lacks intrabar timestamps.
ClientPrice is account-specific with event time, liquidity buckets and tradeable status. Home conversion has distinct gain/loss/position factors.
Take-profit fills at threshold or better; ordinary stop-loss fills at threshold or worse; default liquidation sides are bid for a long and ask for a short.
Trade realized P&L and financing are separate fields; opened/closed execution times and dependent protections have their own evidence.

changesMade: Only this local research audit script and its JSON output; no live order, setting, deployment or strategy rule.
